field.name: weld_force_longitudinal

label.en: Weld force along the weld axis F_w,par,Ed (0 = not given)
label.de: Nahtkraft in Nahtrichtung F_w,par,Ed (0 = nicht angegeben)

field.doc: 🔥 Design force on the fillet weld group of the joint along the weld axis F_w,par,Ed, the source of tau_par in the directional method of EN 1993-1-8 4.5.3.2 (throat stress = force / (a l_w)); 0 = not given, the force then does not enter the weld check and no value is assumed.
